_comment: The exact Hugging Face snapshot of every local model the measurements used. A rerun
pins to these (reproduce.py), because the example configs name a model, not a revision,
and a fresh machine would otherwise download whatever is served today.
Taken from the snapshot each committed run recorded. Two runs predate that recording
(the fabriceyhc fine-tunes, revision 'unavailable' in their fingerprints); their entries
are the commit REFERENCE.md cites, which is also each repository's latest commit, unchanged
since 2021-09-21 -- so it is the only revision those runs could have downloaded.
`self_test` checks this table against every committed run and against REFERENCE.md.
